scope: 26 direct UniPerf event-calling methods in this DEX. PowerGenie and compositor callers are documented separately. Dynamic IDs depend on their configuration; this catalog is not evidence for every external configuration.

methods.behavior: Watch-only finishBooting sends event 13242; absent from the pinned action table.
Voice wakeup sends event 4108; absent from the pinned action table.
Wake-readiness gates stale timestamps, boot/system readiness and proximity before event 4102 start [0]. Not a generic screen-on hook.
Wake-readiness cancellation in the active brightness-wait path emits 4102 [-1]; successful normal wake completion takes another path.
Handler key-down boost sends event 13200 with an empty payload; absent from the pinned table.
Nonzero configured benchmark command: [0] on enable, [-1] on disable. Benchmark exceptions are not ported.
Configured game level resolves a command; null configuration or unresolved command -1 is rejected; enter [0], exit [-1].
Cancel app-start-on-fire with 4121 [-1]; command absent from the pinned table.
Start app-start-on-fire with 4121 [0]; command absent from the pinned table.
Notification 20225 carries the feature bitmask; native notification handling also updates the on-demand-boost switch.

Screen notifications 20226 [1/0], replace pending screen messages and delay screen-off work 5000ms. Input-method show 13119 uses event34 and positive PID; hide 13121 uses event37 and >150ms debounce. Installer event3 starts 4117 [0], event1 cancels [-1].
Positive per-app configured command from mSpecialAppMap starts with an empty payload.
Cancel each positive queued app command with [-1], then clear the queue.
Positive supplied command ID forwards the supplied single value; nonpositive IDs are rejected.
Reset game scene sends 4120 [-1]; absent from the pinned action table.
Enter game scene sends 4120 [0]; absent from the pinned action table.
High-load configuration requires positive control time and interval, rate-limits requests and sends the selected command with an empty payload.
Handler1 finishes normal scrolling; handler2 renews 4402 [0] every 2800ms while boosted, bounded by a property default17; handler3 finishes horizontal scrolling.
Suppress for foreground game or full-screen mini-game; replace message3, send 4404 [0], mark horizontal boost and schedule its finish using the app/type-limited duration.

Suppress for foreground game or full-screen mini-game; remove pending messages1/2. Nonpositive duration starts 4402 [0] and renewal at 2800ms; positive duration conditionally renews and schedules finish.
If horizontal boost active, cancel 4404 [-1] and clear the flag.
If normal boost active, cancel 4402 [-1], trigger frame checking and clear the flag.
For tracked app background, clear foreground flag, cancel cached command [-1] and zero the cache.
Resolve exact configured info-string match. Zero cancels cached command; unchanged command or nonforeground activity does nothing; replacement cancels old [-1] before new [0].
Stock camera updates the big-memory/LMKD indication without starting 13250 here. Classified non-camera big-memory apps set the flag and start 13250 [0]; other apps trigger scene exit.
If big-memory mode active, cancel 13250 [-1] and clear the flag.
